basic_details.short_information: One Project Assistant post in the ISG group at CRIS, New Delhi, is open only to retired Railway Employees of Indian Railways who were in Pay Level-7/8/9 as per 7th CPC (Level-8/9/10 under MACP) and are not more than 62 years of age on the closing date. content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee, the selection process or the minimum educational qualification, and it gives the pay only as "As per CRIS norms".

content_sections.heading: About CRIS
content_sections.text: The Centre for Railway Information Systems (CRIS) is an organisation of the Ministry of Railways, Government of India, located at Chanakyapuri, New Delhi 110021. This vacancy is for its ISG project and group, as printed in the notice, and the post is located at CRIS, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications from retired Railway Officials for a post-retirement assignment. The eligibility conditions for the Project Assistant post are: Service background: Retired Railway Employee of Indian Railways in Pay Level-7/8/9 as per 7th CPC (Level-8/9/10 under MACP as per 7th CPC). Age: The applicant should not be more than 62 years of age on the closing date of application (i.e. not retired more than 2 years back). The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Knowledge/experience of project estimation, project proposal, letter correspondences, preparation of indent/tender schedule etc. The applicant should also be well versed of working in MS office. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration for the CRIS Project Assistant is "As per CRIS norms"; the notice prints no amount and does not explain how the pay of a retired employee will be worked out. The engagement period is initially for one year. The notice also says: Duty in shift required: Yes, as per requirement. Holiday working (including Saturday and Sunday): Yes, as per requirement.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CRIS Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Eligible retired railway employees who are willing may apply by Dak or by email. The steps given in the notice are: Fill in the Application Format enclosed with the notice (page 2 of the notice). Attach a copy of PPO/Service and Experience certificate. The form itself asks for a legible copy of PPO to be enclosed. Sign the form as the applicant. Send the application by Dak, or by email to [email protected] in PDF format. Make sure it is sent within 30 days from the date of publication on the CRIS website. The notice does not give a separate postal address for applications sent by Dak; the address printed on the notice is Chanakyapuri, New Delhi 110021. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CRIS Recruitment 2026 for Project Assistant?
faq.answer: Vacancy Notice No. 60/2026 has one (1) Project Assistant post at CRIS, New Delhi, in the ISG project and group.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CRIS Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The closing date is 30 days from the date of publication on the CRIS website, which is about 3 December 2026 when counted 30 days from the notice date of 3 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the CRIS Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Only retired Railway Employees of Indian Railways who were in Pay Level-7/8/9 as per 7th CPC (Level-8/9/10 under MACP as per 7th CPC) can apply for this post-retirement assignment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the CRIS Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The applicant should not be more than 62 years of age on the closing date of application, which means not retired more than 2 years back.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the CRIS Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The remuneration is "As per CRIS norms"; the notice does not print an amount or a pay formula for retired employees.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the CRIS Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Fill in the enclosed application format, attach a copy of PPO/Service and Experience certificate, and send it by Dak or by email to [email protected] in PDF format.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the CRIS Project Assistant engagement?
faq.answer: The engagement period is initially for one year.

faq.question: Q8. Does the CRIS Project Assistant have to work in shifts or on holidays?
faq.answer: Yes, duty in shift and holiday working (including Saturday and Sunday) are required as per requirement.

faq.question: Q9. What experience is desirable for the CRIS Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Knowledge/experience of project estimation, project proposal, letter correspondences and preparation of indent/tender schedule is desirable, and the applicant should also be well versed in working in MS Office.
